results.title: Dual SSD SATA adapter with Samsung 860 EVO SSD and 2.5-inch enclosure.jpg
results.desc: This photo shows the dual SSD to SATA adapter with a Samsung 860 EVO M.2 SATA SSD inserted and the matching 2.5-inch enclosure positioned nearby. The adapter can accommodate one M.2 NGFF (SATA, B-key/B+M-key) or mSATA SSD at a time, selected by a sliding physical switch. Only SATA protocol SSDs and not NVMe or PCIe drives are supported. The enclosure allows the assembly to be used as a 2.5-inch SATA SSD
